title: Nourishing Dry Mexican Onion Enchiladas
description: Tender and cultured, these vegan-friendly enchiladas are a perfect date-night dish featuring dry Mexican onions, inspired by the Chiapan cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rehydrate the dry Mexican onions by soaking them in water for 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the rehydrated onions to the pan and cook until they are tender.
Add the chipotle peppers, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir well.
In a separate pan, warm the corn tortillas over medium heat for 30 seconds on each side.
To assemble the enchiladas, dip each tortilla in the onion mixture and roll it up.
Place the rolled tortillas in a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes.
